note: T-3091: the 8 self-change holds of 2026-11-04/05 (T-3023, T-3026 x3, T-3029, T-3034, T-3053, T-3047), rebuilt as rises on the recorded A/A benches in selfgate-aa/ (load ~2 per core). The ledger kept each hold's verdict rows, not its benches, so a hold is its recorded hook and rise (ratio of the branch's timings to the base's) applied in the pairs it showed in; T-3026's first hold is the one with every hook up ~35% together. Seven of the eight show in only 2 of the 3 pairs, so the HOLD = 3 rule passes them with or without T-3091's allowances; only T-3026 first (all 3 pairs) reaches the new code, and there the machine divisor is clamped to what the base itself moved, so that rise is still HELD (8 hooks): a uniform +35% on a loaded bench is not excused as the machine, and the number was not tuned to pass.
